about: Recording R0.8 20261022-1227 'rack3' (146.4 s). Checked by eye by Claude from the video before either system was run (1 fps overview; 5-15 fps around every shot). Times are seconds from the start of the recording, 'at' = cue strike, about +/-0.3 s. Not reviewed by the player. A piece of chalk sits on the near rail by the near side pocket from ~51 s and on the near-left rail later (not a ball).
